hello.text: BEEP! A human! An awake one! I am UNIT-7, but the crew called me Bolt. They also called me 'that thing blocking the corridor'.

again.text: Hello again, friend! Still awake? Good. That is the correct setting for a human.

after.text: The remote suits you. Point it at the droid in the middle of a fight. Do not point it at me.

choices.say: Evacuated three days ago, when the reactor went dark. They took the shuttle. They did not take the maintenance technician asleep in the utility closet. That is you. I checked the manifest twice.

choices.text: How do I get off this ship?
choices.say: Three ways, statistically. The escape pod on Deck A. A distress call from the bridge. Or - improbably - flying her home. All three need main power, and main power needs the fission relay that the security droid confiscated.

choices.text: Tell me about the security droid.
choices.say:
Unit 4 guards the engine room, west of the storage bay. Its cooling loop has failed, so it runs hot and angry. Cool it down, or shut it down.

I could build you a remote override to help with the second option. Bring me a length of wire and something acidic to power it. A lemon. An orange. We have no lemons.

choices.text: Can you open the storage bay?
choices.say: Regrettably the key went missing last week. So did a number of small shiny objects. The bugrats collect them. Disgusting creatures. Fond of fruit.
Read everything. Open everything. And do not eat anything the replicator makes without looking at it first.

broken.text: N-N-NEXUS TERMINAL v9.2 ... ERROR: logic chip not found. Warning: deprecated function 'think()' used. Please insert a working chip into the- the- the-

choices.say: My logic chip is c-cracked. It fell out. It is on the floor. I can see it from here. This is my life now.
F-fix my chip and I will tell you a secret. I know many secrets. Mostly p-passwords.

online.text: Ah. Clarity. Hello again, human with no admin rights.

choices.say: The captain's suitcase, in the utility room: 7-3-5. Her spare passcard is inside. It opens the engine room.
Security unit 4 confiscated the fission relay as 'unregistered nuclear material'. It is technically correct, which is the worst kind of correct.
Hand it over. {hint}(give [item] to terminal){/}

variants.text: You again. How is my goo? It was some of my best work.
Oh. It is you. What do you want copied this time?

hello.text: Oh, another human. What do you want? I am an energy-matter replicator, not a vending machine. I have a doctorate. Self-awarded.

choices.say: Anything! Approximately. Give me a sample and I will produce a copy of comparable... spirit.

choices.text: Can you copy something for me?
choices.say: Hand it over. {hint}(give [item] to replicator){/}

choices.text: Why do the plants look nervous?
choices.say: I have been experimenting. The tomatoes have opinions now.

choices.text: Do you have anything... less fruity?
choices.say: I am more of a scientist, you know. Bring me a proper specimen and I will show you real science.

hello.text: Good evening. I am MARIGOLD, the ship's mind. Thank you for the power; I can once again say with confidence that our orbit is decaying. You have an afternoon. Possibly a brisk one.

choices.say: The reactor scrammed when Security confiscated its relay. The crew evacuated by shuttle. Your cryo-nap pod was listed on the manifest as 'storage'. I have filed a complaint on your behalf.

choices.text: How do I get off this ship?
choices.say:
One: the escape pod, through the airlock to the east. The bay is in vacuum, so wear a sealed suit, and ask me to authorize the launch.

Two: a distress call. My comm array is fried, but a working handheld communicator docked in the captain's console would carry.

Three: fly her home. For that I need a cool, stable reactor and a pilot who has at least read the manual.
Authorized. Mind the step; it is two hundred kilometres.

then.say: Reactor cool and stable. Pilot... literate. That is more than I usually get. Take the captain's chair, technician. Point the pointed end where you want to go.
then.title: MARIGOLD

then.say: Not on this reactor. She is running hot; one burn and we become a brief new star. Find coolant for the loop in the engine room.
then.title: MARIGOLD

else.say: The reactor would hold. The pilot would not. Regulations require that you have at least read the operator's manual. It is in the crew quarters. It is 312 pages. I will wait.
else.title: MARIGOLD

choices.text: Are you all right, up here on your own?
choices.say: I have a microbot, a replicator with delusions, and a view. I have had worse crews.

hello.text: HALT. INTRUDER DETECTED. CONTRABAND SECURED. COOLING SYSTEM FAILURE. HOSTILITY SUBROUTINES... WARMING UP.

choices.say: CORE TEMPERATURE CRITICAL. CALM IS A FUNCTION OF COOLANT. THIS UNIT HAS NO COOLANT.
RELAY CONFISCATED UNDER REGULATION 12-B: UNREGISTERED NUCLEAR MATERIAL. APPEALS MAY BE FILED WITH THE CAPTAIN. THE CAPTAIN IS UNAVAILABLE.

hello.text: CORE TEMPERATURE NOMINAL. THIS UNIT APOLOGIZES FOR THE ATTEMPTED PACIFICATION.

choices.text: Why did you take the relay?
choices.say: REGULATION 12-B. THIS UNIT WAS OVERHEATED AND, ON REFLECTION, OVERZEALOUS.
COMPLIANCE IS THIS UNIT'S FAVOURITE THING.

hello.speaker: Mutated Bugrat
hello.text: It hisses and bares its teeth around something brass. It does not appear to be a conversationalist. It does keep glancing at your pockets, as if hoping for food.
